thread.title: Qualcomm Says Apple Owes $7B in Royalty Payments

author: Elise Reuter
title: Qualcomm Says Apple Owes $7B in Royalty Payments
text:
Tweet
Qualcomm Inc. said former customer Apple Inc. is $7 billion behind in royalty payments. According to Bloomberg , the San Diego-based chip manufacturer brought forward the argument in a Friday court hearing at the Federal Court in San Diego.
The lawsuit extends back to early 2017, when Apple (NYSE: AAPL) filed a complaint against Qualcomm (Nasdaq: QCOM), saying the company owed it $1 billion in rebates . While Apple was previously one of Qualcomm’s biggest customers, for the iPhone 7, Apple used Intel chips in some of its phones. A few months after it filed the suit, Apple stopped making royalty payments to Qualcomm.
The lawsuit is one of many legal disputes between the two tech giants. In September, Qualcomm accused Apple of sharing trade secrets with competitor Intel. The companies also have multiple outstanding patent lawsuits against each other.
